def stat(input_str):
    if not input_str.strip():
        return ""

    def parse_time(time_str):
        h, m, s = time_str.split('|')
        return int(h) * 3600 + int(m) * 60 + int(s)

    def format_time(total_seconds):
        hh = total_seconds // 3600
        remaining = total_seconds % 3600
        mm = remaining // 60
        ss = remaining % 60
        return f"{hh:02d}|{mm:02d}|{ss:02d}"

    times = [parse_time(part.strip()) for part in input_str.split(',') if part.strip()]
    times_sorted = sorted(times)

    range_val = times_sorted[-1] - times_sorted[0]
    avg_val = sum(times_sorted) // len(times_sorted)
    median_val = (times_sorted[len(times_sorted)//2] + times_sorted[(len(times_sorted)-1)//2]) // 2 if len(times_sorted) % 2 == 0 else times_sorted[len(times_sorted)//2]

    return f"Range: {format_time(range_val)} Average: {format_time(avg_val)} Median: {format_time(median_val)}"
